# Real-recording fixtures

ARCHITECTURE_V1.md §7.2: short real recordings may live here as *regression*
evidence. They are never the only evidence for a DSP change.

WAV files under this directory are gitignored except when a contributor
adds one with a written CC0 declaration in this file.
